posts.text: Volunteering at the city archive this Thursday, come say hi if you are around. Reminder that the bike repair cafe is open every Saturday at the bike co-op. The cat next door learned to open our gate. We are negotiating. Started a reading log and I am already behind by 25 pages. Is it just me or did Blender get noticeably faster in the last release? Reading Project Hail Mary again and it hits differently this year. Spent the whole morning at the riverside path and saw 12 herons. Accidentally made enough ramen for 76 people. Neighbours are getting some.
